import asyncio
import json
import logging
from typing import Any

from aichat_sdk.asr.asr_client import AsrWebSocketClient
from aichat_sdk.config import ASR_SERVER_WS_URL
from aichat_sdk.llm import LlmAgent
from aichat_sdk.llm.mcp import get_default_chat_tools
from aichat_sdk.llm.type_enum import AgentInfo, DeviceInfo
from aichat_sdk.tts import DEFAULT_TTS_ENGINE, get_tts_client, get_tts_engines
from aichat_sdk.utils.opus_codec import (
    OpusStreamDecoder,
    OpusStreamEncoder,
    PcmStreamResampler,
)

__version__ = "0.1.2"


logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

IDLE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 60
IDLE_FAREWELL_PROMPT = (
    "用户已长时间没有说话，本次会话即将自动结束。"
    "请直接输出一两句简短自然的道别话，可以结合刚才聊到的内容。"
    "只输出纯文本，不要调用任何工具，也不要向用户提问或期待回复。"
)


class ChatBot:
    def __init__(
        self,
        tts_engine: str = DEFAULT_TTS_ENGINE,
        input_sample_rate: int = 24000,  # Opus 编码采样率(限 8k/12k/16k/24k/48k)，TTS 源 PCM 采样率不同时会自动重采样;
        output_sample_rate: int = 24000,  # 宿主解码后拿到的 PCM 采样率(任意),解码器用 create_opus_decoder() 创建。
        asr_server_url: str = ASR_SERVER_WS_URL,  # ASR 服务地址
        send_idle_farewell: bool = True,  # 空闲超时后是否先发送告别语,为 False 时直接关闭会话。
        user_info: DeviceInfo = DeviceInfo(timezone=8, city="北京"),  # 用户信息
        agent_info: AgentInfo = AgentInfo(),  # 角色信息
    ) -> None:
        """input_sample_rate:Opus 编码采样率(限 8k/12k/16k/24k/48k)，
        TTS 源 PCM 采样率不同时会自动重采样;
        output_sample_rate:宿主解码后拿到的 PCM 采样率(任意),解码器用 create_opus_decoder() 创建。
        send_idle_farewell:空闲超时后是否先发送告别语,为 False 时直接关闭会话。
        """
        self.tts = get_tts_client(tts_engine)
        self.asr = AsrWebSocketClient(asr_server_url)

        self.output_sample_rate = output_sample_rate
        self._send_idle_farewell = send_idle_farewell
        self.llm = LlmAgent(user_info=user_info, agent_info=agent_info)
        self._queue: asyncio.Queue[dict[str, Any]] = asyncio.Queue()
        self._input_sample_rate = input_sample_rate
        self._opus_encoder = OpusStreamEncoder(input_sample_rate)
        self._pcm_resampler: PcmStreamResampler | None = None
        self._audio_text = ""
        self._audio_terminal_sent = True
        self._tts_session_started = False
        self._chat_task: asyncio.Task | None = None
        self._session_lock = asyncio.Lock()
        self._asr_dispatch_tasks: set[asyncio.Task] = set()
        self._pending_mcp_call: tuple[str, dict[str, Any]] | None = None
        # 宿主从队列取走 audio_finish 时置位，等"真正播完"用
        self._audio_finish_consumed = asyncio.Event()

        self._is_session_closed = False
        self._idle_task: asyncio.Task | None = None

    def create_opus_decoder(self) -> OpusStreamDecoder:
        """给宿主建配套解码器,输出 output_sample_rate 的 PCM,按同样的采样率播放。"""
        return OpusStreamDecoder(self.output_sample_rate)

    def audio_callback(self, indata, frames, time, status) -> None:
        """把宿主采集的 16 kHz 单声道 Float32 PCM 发往 ASR 服务。"""
        self.asr.audio_callback(indata, frames, time, status)

    def _start_idle_timer(self):
        self._cancel_idle_timer()
        if not self._is_session_closed:
            self._idle_task = asyncio.create_task(self._idle_farewell())

    def _cancel_idle_timer(self):
        if self._idle_task and not self._idle_task.done():
            self._idle_task.cancel()
        self._idle_task = None

    async def _idle_farewell(self):
        """超过 IDLE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS 用户无回复,按配置告别或直接结束会话。"""
        await asyncio.sleep(IDLE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS)
        # 先清引用再 send_text,否则 send_text 里的 abort 会把当前任务自己 cancel 掉
        self._idle_task = None
        self._is_session_closed = True

        if self._send_idle_farewell:
            logger.info(f"[idle] 用户超过 {IDLE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS}s 未回复,推送告别")
            await self.send_text("", response_instructions=IDLE_FAREWELL_PROMPT, role="user")
            # await self.send_text(IDLE_FAREWELL_PROMPT, role="system")

        else:
            logger.info(f"[idle] 用户超过 {IDLE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS}s 未回复,直接关闭")
            await self._queue.put({"type": "close"})

    async def receive_item(self):
        item = await self._queue.get()
        if item.get("type") == "lyric":
            logger.info(f"[music] lyric: {item['data']}")
        # 空闲计时以宿主消费(≈播放)节奏为准:取到 audio_finish 即真正播完、开始计时;
        # 音频是瞬间推满队列的(整首歌几秒推完),按推送侧计时会在播放途中误触发。
        elif item.get("type") == "audio_finish":
            self._start_idle_timer()
            self._audio_finish_consumed.set()
        elif item.get("type") == "audio":
            self._cancel_idle_timer()
        return item

    async def reg_llm(self):

        @self.llm.on("text")
        async def handle_chat_text(text: str):
            # 会话开着但 10s 没收到文本，服务端就把它作废:之后送的字不再出声,
            # FinishSession 也可能不回(实测 9s 正常、10s 起必挂)。工具调用和
            # LLM 首字慢都能轻松撑过 10s，所以等真的有字了再开会话。
            if not self._tts_session_started:
                self._tts_session_started = True
                await self.tts.start_session()
            await self.tts.send_char(text)

        @self.llm.on("tool")
        async def handle_chat_tool(payload: dict):
            arguments_str = payload["arguments"]
            if len(arguments_str) > 50:
                arguments_str = arguments_str[:50] + "..."
            logger.info(f"[tool] tool_call: {payload['name']} ({arguments_str})")
            await self._queue.put({"type": "tool", "data": payload})

        @self.llm.on("before_tool_exec")
        async def handle_chat_before_tool_exec(text: str):
            await self._wait_audio_played(text)

        @self.llm.on("tool_results")
        async def handle_chat_tool_results(payload: list[dict]):
            payload_str = json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False)
            if len(payload_str) > 100:
                payload_str = payload_str[:100] + "..."
            logger.info(f"[tool] tool_results: {payload_str}")
            await self._queue.put({"type": "tool_results", "data": payload})

            if any(msg.get("name") == "end_session" for msg in payload):
                self._is_session_closed = True

            for msg in payload:
                if msg["name"] == "play_music":
                    try:
                        result = json.loads(msg["content"])
                        mcp_name = result.get("mcp")
                        song = result.get("song")
                        if isinstance(mcp_name, str) and isinstance(song, str):
                            self._pending_mcp_call = (mcp_name, {"song": song})
                    except (json.JSONDecodeError, KeyError, TypeError):
                        pass  # 结果里没有 path 说明选歌失败，无需播放

        @self.llm.on("finish")
        async def handle_chat_finish(text: str):
            self._audio_text = text
            await self.tts.finish_session()
            # 正常实现会在 finish_session 内触发 audio_finish；这里作为协议
            # 兜底，防止第三方 TTS 返回却忘记发终结事件。
            await self._finish_audio_and_followups()

    async def reg_tts(self):

        @self.tts.on("audio")
        async def handle_audio(pcm_data: bytes):
            if self._pcm_resampler is not None:
                pcm_data = self._pcm_resampler.resample(pcm_data)
            for packet in self._opus_encoder.encode(pcm_data):
                await self._queue.put({"type": "audio", "data": packet})

        @self.tts.on("audio_finish")
        async def handle_audio_finish():
            await self._finish_audio_and_followups()

        @self.tts.on("sentence_start")
        async def handle_sentence_start(text: str):
            logger.info(f"[tts] {text}")
            await self._queue.put({"type": "sentence_start", "data": text})

        @self.tts.on("sentence_end")
        async def handle_sentence_end(text: str):
            await self._queue.put({"type": "sentence_end", "data": text})

    async def reg_asr(self):
        @self.asr.on("stt")
        async def handle_stt(payload: dict):
            logger.info(f"[asr] {payload['content']}")
            self.tts.set_last_context_text(payload["content"])
            kwargs = {"audio_url": payload.get("audio_url")}
            if "speaker" in payload:
                kwargs["speaker"] = payload["speaker"]
            task = asyncio.create_task(self.send_text(payload["content"], **kwargs))
            self._asr_dispatch_tasks.add(task)
            task.add_done_callback(self._finish_asr_dispatch)

        @self.asr.on("error")
        async def handle_asr_error(payload: dict):
            logger.error("[asr] server error: %s", payload)

    def _finish_asr_dispatch(self, task: asyncio.Task) -> None:
        self._asr_dispatch_tasks.discard(task)
        if task.cancelled():
            return
        error = task.exception()
        if error is not None:
            logger.error(
                "ASR result dispatch failed",
                exc_info=(type(error), error, error.__traceback__),
            )

    async def initialize(self):
        await self.reg_llm()
        await self.reg_tts()
        await self.reg_asr()
        try:
            await self.asr.connect()
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"ASR connect failed: {e}")
            await self.asr.close()
            exit(1)
        try:
            await self.tts.connect()
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"TTS connect failed: {e}")
            await self.tts.close()
            exit(1)
        # 工具列表是懒构建的，不预热的话第一次拉起外部 MCP server（stdio 子进程）
        # 的耗时会算进第一轮回复；构建是阻塞调用，放线程里跑不挡事件循环。
        await asyncio.to_thread(get_default_chat_tools)
        source_sample_rate = getattr(
            self.tts,
            "sample_rate",
            self._input_sample_rate,
        )
        if source_sample_rate != self._input_sample_rate:
            self._pcm_resampler = PcmStreamResampler(
                source_sample_rate,
                self._input_sample_rate,
            )
        self._start_idle_timer()

    async def close(self):
        self._cancel_idle_timer()
        for task in self._asr_dispatch_tasks:
            task.cancel()
        if self._asr_dispatch_tasks:
            await asyncio.gather(
                *self._asr_dispatch_tasks,
                return_exceptions=True,
            )
        self._asr_dispatch_tasks.clear()
        await self.abort()
        await self.asr.close()
        close = getattr(self.tts, "close", None) or getattr(
            self.tts,
            "disconnect",
            None,
        )
        if close is not None:
            await close()

    async def _run_session_task(self, coroutine_factory) -> None:
        async with self._session_lock:
            await self._abort_locked()
            task = asyncio.create_task(coroutine_factory())
            self._chat_task = task
        try:
            await task
        except asyncio.CancelledError:
            # 被下一轮会话替换时，只有子任务被 cancel，当前包装任务本身没有
            # cancellation request；调用方主动 cancel 时则清理会话并继续传播。
            if asyncio.current_task().cancelling():
                async with self._session_lock:
                    if self._chat_task is task:
                        await self._abort_locked(notify_host=True)
                raise
        finally:
            async with self._session_lock:
                if self._chat_task is task:
                    self._chat_task = None

    async def send_text(
        self, user_text: str, role: str = "user", response_instructions: str = None,
        audio_url: str | None = None, speaker: str | None = None,
    ):
        """speaker 是本条消息的说话人编号或已匹配姓名；audio_url 只供宿主回放，不发给 LLM。"""
        await self._run_session_task(
            lambda: self._run_chat(user_text, role, response_instructions, audio_url, speaker)
        )

    async def _run_chat(
        self, user_text: str, role, response_instructions,
        audio_url: str | None = None, speaker: str | None = None,
    ):
        self._prepare_audio_session()
        try:
            await self._queue.put({"type": "stt", "data": user_text})
            await self.llm.chat(user_text, role, response_instructions, audio_url=audio_url, speaker=speaker)
        except asyncio.CancelledError:
            raise
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("chat pipeline failed")
            await self._fail_audio_session()
            raise

    async def send_tts_text(self, text: str):
        await self._run_session_task(lambda: self._run_tts_text(text))

    async def _run_tts_text(self, text: str) -> None:
        self._prepare_audio_session()
        try:
            await self.tts.start_session()
            await self.tts.send_char(text)
            self._audio_text = text
            await self.tts.finish_session()
            await self._finish_audio_and_followups()
        except asyncio.CancelledError:
            raise
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("direct TTS pipeline failed")
            await self._fail_audio_session()
            raise

    async def _wait_audio_played(self, text: str) -> None:
        """工具执行前等本轮已出声的文本真正播完。

        先收掉 TTS 会话、推 audio_finish，再等宿主把它取走（音频是瞬间推满队列的，
        只有宿主取到 audio_finish 才算播完）。之后按新一段音频处理:工具返回后的
        回复重新开会话、结束时再推一条 audio_finish。一个字都没吐过就不用等，
        也不能去收一个没开过的会话。
        """
        if not self._tts_session_started:
            return
        self._audio_text = text
        self._audio_finish_consumed.clear()
        await self.tts.finish_session()
        await self._finish_audio_and_followups()
        await self._audio_finish_consumed.wait()
        # 取走 audio_finish 会起空闲计时，但工具还在跑，不算用户没回复
        self._cancel_idle_timer()
        self._prepare_audio_session()

    def _prepare_audio_session(self) -> None:
        self._audio_text = ""
        self._audio_terminal_sent = False
        self._tts_session_started = False

    async def _enqueue_audio_finish(self) -> bool:
        if self._audio_terminal_sent:
            return False
        self._audio_terminal_sent = True
        if self._pcm_resampler is not None:
            pcm = self._pcm_resampler.flush()
            for packet in self._opus_encoder.encode(pcm):
                await self._queue.put({"type": "audio", "data": packet})
        for packet in self._opus_encoder.flush():
            await self._queue.put({"type": "audio", "data": packet})
        await self._queue.put({"type": "audio_finish", "data": self._audio_text})
        return True

    async def _finish_audio_and_followups(self) -> None:
        if not await self._enqueue_audio_finish():
            return
        if self._is_session_closed:
            await self._queue.put({"type": "close"})
        elif self._pending_mcp_call:
            # 等本轮回复的语音播完再开始放歌，避免歌声盖住回复
            name, args = self._pending_mcp_call
            self._pending_mcp_call = None
            async for data in self.llm.stream_mcp_tool(name, args):
                await self._queue.put(data)

    async def _fail_audio_session(self) -> None:
        try:
            await self.tts.abort()
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("failed to abort TTS after pipeline error")
        await self._enqueue_audio_finish()

    async def abort(self):
        async with self._session_lock:
            await self._abort_locked(notify_host=True)

    async def _abort_locked(self, *, notify_host: bool = False) -> None:
        self._cancel_idle_timer()
        session_was_active = not self._audio_terminal_sent
        task = self._chat_task
        if task and task is not asyncio.current_task() and not task.done():
            task.cancel()
            await asyncio.gather(task, return_exceptions=True)

        if self._chat_task is task:
            self._chat_task = None
        self._pending_mcp_call = None
        try:
            await self.tts.abort()
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("failed to abort TTS session")
        if self._pcm_resampler is not None:
            self._pcm_resampler.reset()
        self._opus_encoder.reset()
        removed_audio_finish = False
        while not self._queue.empty():
            item = self._queue.get_nowait()
            removed_audio_finish |= item.get("type") == "audio_finish"
        self._audio_text = ""
        self._audio_terminal_sent = True
        if notify_host and (session_was_active or removed_audio_finish):
            await self._queue.put({"type": "audio_finish", "data": ""})

def _match_song(song: str, names: list[str]) -> str | None:
    if not song:
        return random.choice(names)
    for name in names:
        if song == name or song in name or name in song:
            return name
    matches = difflib.get_close_matches(song, names, n=1, cutoff=0.5)
    return matches[0] if matches else None

SAMPLE_RATE = 16000
CHUNK_SIZE_MS = 240
BLOCK_SIZE = SAMPLE_RATE * CHUNK_SIZE_MS // 1000


class AsrWebSocketClient(AsyncEventEmitter):
    """Stream microphone PCM to the ASR WebSocket service."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        url: str,
        *,
        reconnect_delay: float = 1.0,
        max_audio_queue: int = 64,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.url = url
        # 服务端 stt 里的 audio_url 是相对路径（/audio/...），按 ws 地址换成同主机的 http 地址
        parts = urlsplit(url)
        self._http_base = urlunsplit(("https" if parts.scheme == "wss" else "http", parts.netloc, "", "", ""))
        self.reconnect_delay = reconnect_delay
        self._audio_queue: asyncio.Queue[np.ndarray] = asyncio.Queue(maxsize=max_audio_queue)
        self._loop: asyncio.AbstractEventLoop | None = None
        self._websocket: Any | None = None
        self._manager_task: asyncio.Task[None] | None = None
        self._closing = False

    @property
    def connected(self) -> bool:
        return self._websocket is not None

    async def connect(self) -> None:
        """Connect once, then keep reconnecting in the background if disconnected."""
        if self._manager_task is not None and not self._manager_task.done():
            return

        self._loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
        self._closing = False
        websocket = await websockets.connect(self.url, max_size=1024 * 1024)
        self._websocket = websocket
        self._manager_task = asyncio.create_task(
            self._connection_manager(websocket),
            name="asr-websocket-connection",
        )

    async def close(self) -> None:
        self._closing = True
        task = self._manager_task
        self._manager_task = None
        if task is not None:
            task.cancel()
            await asyncio.gather(task, return_exceptions=True)
        self._websocket = None
        self._clear_audio_queue()

    def audio_callback(
        self,
        indata: np.ndarray,
        frames: int,
        time: Any,
        status: Any,
    ) -> None:
        """sounddevice callback: copy mono float samples into the asyncio loop."""
        del frames, time
        if status:
            logger.warning("ASR audio input status: %s", status)
        loop = self._loop
        if loop is None or not loop.is_running() or not self.connected:
            return

        audio = np.asarray(indata)
        if audio.ndim == 2:
            audio = audio[:, 0]
        chunk = np.ascontiguousarray(audio, dtype="<f4").copy()
        loop.call_soon_threadsafe(self._enqueue_audio, chunk)

    async def send_audio(self, chunk: np.ndarray) -> bool:
        """Queue one PCM chunk; return False while the service is disconnected."""
        if not self.connected:
            return False
        audio = np.asarray(chunk)
        if audio.ndim == 2:
            audio = audio[:, 0]
        self._enqueue_audio(np.ascontiguousarray(audio, dtype="<f4").copy())
        return True

    def _enqueue_audio(self, chunk: np.ndarray) -> None:
        if not self.connected:
            return
        if self._audio_queue.full():
            self._audio_queue.get_nowait()
            logger.warning("ASR audio queue full; dropped the oldest chunk")
        self._audio_queue.put_nowait(chunk)

    def _clear_audio_queue(self) -> None:
        while not self._audio_queue.empty():
            self._audio_queue.get_nowait()

    async def _connection_manager(self, websocket: Any) -> None:
        try:
            while not self._closing:
                self._websocket = websocket
                logger.info("ASR WebSocket connected: %s", self.url)
                await self.emit("connected")
                try:
                    await self._run_connection(websocket)
                except asyncio.CancelledError:
                    raise
                except Exception:
                    logger.exception("ASR WebSocket connection lost")
                finally:
                    self._websocket = None
                    try:
                        await websocket.close()
                    except Exception:
                        logger.exception("failed to close ASR WebSocket")
                    self._clear_audio_queue()

                if self._closing:
                    break
                await self.emit("disconnected")
                websocket = await self._reconnect()
        finally:
            self._websocket = None

    async def _reconnect(self) -> Any:
        while not self._closing:
            await asyncio.sleep(self.reconnect_delay)
            try:
                websocket = await websockets.connect(
                    self.url,
                    max_size=1024 * 1024,
                )
                logger.info("ASR WebSocket reconnected: %s", self.url)
                return websocket
            except asyncio.CancelledError:
                raise
            except Exception:
                logger.exception("ASR WebSocket reconnect failed")
        raise asyncio.CancelledError

    async def _run_connection(self, websocket: Any) -> None:
        sender = asyncio.create_task(
            self._send_audio(websocket),
            name="asr-websocket-sender",
        )
        receiver = asyncio.create_task(
            self._receive_results(websocket),
            name="asr-websocket-receiver",
        )
        tasks = {sender, receiver}
        try:
            done, _ = await asyncio.wait(
                tasks,
                return_when=asyncio.FIRST_COMPLETED,
            )
            for task in done:
                task.result()
        finally:
            for task in tasks:
                task.cancel()
            await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=True)

    async def _send_audio(self, websocket: Any) -> None:
        while True:
            chunk = await self._audio_queue.get()
            await websocket.send(chunk.tobytes())

    async def _receive_results(self, websocket: Any) -> None:
        async for raw_message in websocket:
            if not isinstance(raw_message, str):
                logger.warning("ignored binary ASR server message")
                continue
            try:
                message = json.loads(raw_message)
            except json.JSONDecodeError:
                logger.warning("ignored invalid ASR server JSON: %r", raw_message)
                continue

            message_type = message.get("type")
            if message_type == "stt":
                payload = dict(message)
                payload.pop("type", None)
                audio_url = payload.get("audio_url")
                if isinstance(audio_url, str) and audio_url.startswith("/"):
                    payload["audio_url"] = self._http_base + audio_url
                await self.emit("stt", payload)
            elif message_type == "error":
                await self.emit("error", message)
            else:
                logger.warning("ignored unknown ASR server message: %r", message)

import asyncio
import inspect
import logging
from typing import Any, Callable

logger = logging.getLogger("aichat_sdk")


class AsyncEventEmitter:
    """通用异步事件发射器，支持同步/异步处理函数混用。

    用法::

        class Foo(AsyncEventEmitter):
            ...

        foo = Foo()

        @foo.on("some_event")
        async def handle(payload): ...

        await foo.emit("some_event", payload)
    """

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._handlers: dict[str, list[Callable[..., Any]]] = {}

    def on(self, event_type: str) -> Callable[[Callable[..., Any]], Callable[..., Any]]:
        """装饰器，订阅指定类型的事件。"""

        def decorator(func: Callable[..., Any]) -> Callable[..., Any]:
            self._handlers.setdefault(event_type, []).append(func)
            return func

        return decorator

    def off(self, event_type: str, func: Callable[..., Any]) -> None:
        """取消订阅某个处理函数。"""
        handlers = self._handlers.get(event_type)
        if handlers and func in handlers:
            handlers.remove(func)

    async def emit(self, event_type: str, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> None:
        """触发事件，依次调用所有已注册的处理函数。单个处理函数异常不影响其余处理函数。"""
        await self._emit(event_type, args, kwargs, suppress_exceptions=True)

    async def emit_strict(
        self,
        event_type: str,
        *args: Any,
        **kwargs: Any,
    ) -> None:
        """触发事件并向调用方传播处理函数异常。

        核心流水线用这个版本，避免 TTS/队列处理失败后 LLM 仍继续运行，
        最终又无法给宿主发送可靠的终结信号。
        """
        await self._emit(event_type, args, kwargs, suppress_exceptions=False)

    async def _emit(
        self,
        event_type: str,
        args: tuple[Any, ...],
        kwargs: dict[str, Any],
        *,
        suppress_exceptions: bool,
    ) -> None:
        for handler in list(self._handlers.get(event_type, [])):
            try:
                if asyncio.iscoroutinefunction(handler):
                    await handler(*args, **kwargs)
                else:
                    result = handler(*args, **kwargs)
                    if inspect.isawaitable(result):
                        await result
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"Error in emit({event_type}): {e}", exc_info=True)
                if not suppress_exceptions:
                    raise

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from importlib import import_module
from typing import Any

DEFAULT_TTS_ENGINE = "bytedancev1"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class _Engine:
    label: str
    client_class: str
    aliases: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    kwargs: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)


_TTS_ENGINES = {
    "bytedancev1": _Engine(
        label="bytedancev1（豆包 v1，24k）",
        client_class="BytedanceTTSClient",
        aliases=("v1",),
        kwargs={"voice_type": "zh_female_wanwanxiaohe_moon_bigtts"},
    ),
    "bytedancev2": _Engine(
        label="bytedancev2（豆包 v2，24k）",
        client_class="BytedanceTTSClient",
        aliases=("v2",),
        kwargs={"voice_type": "zh_female_vv_uranus_bigtts"},
    ),
    "edge": _Engine(label="edge（微软在线，24k）", client_class="EdgeTTSClient", aliases=("edge-tts",)),
    "mimo": _Engine(label="mimo（小米 MiMo，24k）", client_class="MiMoTTSClient"),
}


def get_tts_engines() -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """返回支持的引擎:规范名称 name、显示文字 label、别名 aliases、是否默认 default。"""
    return [
        {"name": name, "label": spec.label, "aliases": list(spec.aliases), "default": name == DEFAULT_TTS_ENGINE}
        for name, spec in _TTS_ENGINES.items()
    ]


def get_tts_client(tts_engine: str = DEFAULT_TTS_ENGINE):
    engine = tts_engine.strip().lower()
    for name, spec in _TTS_ENGINES.items():
        if engine == name or engine in spec.aliases:
            module = import_module(f".{name}.bidirection", package=__name__)
            return getattr(module, spec.client_class)(**spec.kwargs)
    supported = ", ".join(
        name + (f" ({', '.join(spec.aliases)})" if spec.aliases else "")
        for name, spec in _TTS_ENGINES.items()
    )
    raise ValueError(f"未知 tts_engine，支持: {supported}")

# KickPi K7 (RK3576) 上的 Linux + openvela 异构多核（AMP）适配

> 2026 首届 openvela AI 硬件开发者大赛 · **新硬件适配赛道** · 290 队

## 一、作品简介

把 **openvela** 移植到 **KickPi K7（Rockchip RK3576）** 开发板，并做成一个真实的
**AMP（非对称多处理）系统**：在一颗 SoC 上，让 openvela 独占一个 A 核实时运行，
与 Linux 并存共跑。

- **cpu3（Cortex-A53）独占运行 openvela**（NuttShell 交互、实时任务）
- 其余 **7 核（3×A53 + 4×A72）继续运行 Linux**
- 两个操作系统通过**共享内存 + GIC 软中断承载的 RPMsg** 双向通信，Linux 侧表现为
  标准的 `/dev/ttyRPMSG0` 字符设备
- **openvela 侧全离线唤醒词「你好，openvela」**：PDM 麦克风常听，40 维
  log-mel + DS-CNN（纯 C，仅依赖 libm）在小核上每 80ms 推理一次（实测单次
  53ms），检出后经 rpmsg 通知 Linux（`KEY_WAKEUP` input 事件）——大核可睡、
  小核常听的 AMP 语音入口。训练语料经板载扬声器→真实 PDM 麦重录做信道
  自适应，板麦录到的真人对话/底噪作负例参训（v7：真人语音误触 8%→0.4%，
  底噪 120 次/小时→0）。训练/评测/部署全管线见 [`tools/kws/`](tools/kws/)
- **Linux 侧接力做识别**：唤醒之后，Linux 的 7 个核与 **6 TOPS NPU** 承担实时语音
  识别（SenseVoiceSmall）与说话人辨认（ERes2NetV2），两个模型都转成 RKNN 跑在 NPU
  上——声纹 4589 ms → **519 ms**，识别 702 ms → **378 ms**，端到端「说完到出结果」
  约 620 ms。小核常听、大核 + NPU 出结果，见 [`linux-apps/asr-server/`](linux-apps/asr-server/)

**已上板实测通过**：openvela 在 cpu3 稳定运行（心跳精确 500ms）、Linux 7 核不受
影响、`/dev/ttyRPMSG0` 双向回显 50/50 零丢失、openvela NuttShell 在 UART5 可交互。

这是 openvela/NuttX 生态里**首个** “Linux 持有 GIC distributor + openvela 作为同构
A 核 AMP slave” 的公开适配。

## 二、选题方向

**新硬件适配** —— 为 openvela 新增 RK3576 芯片支持与 KickPi K7 板级支持，并突破
“与 Linux 共享 GIC / 与 Linux 主控 RPMsg 互通” 两大工程难点。核心价值在于：同一颗
RK3576 上，用一套硬件同时获得 **Linux 的丰富生态** 与 **openvela 的实时确定性**，
省一颗 MCU、省一套外围电路。

**完整、可照做的复现步骤在 [`board/contest_board/README.md`](board/contest_board/README.md)。** 概览：

0. **（可选）不编译，直接烧预编译固件** —— `update.img` 首刷 / `amp.img` 迭代，
   下载 [2026-09-15 固件 Release](https://github.com/open-vela/contest2026_290_dairoot/releases/tag/firmware-2026-09-15)。
   整包以 `update.img.gz` 提供，需先解压并校验；文件 SHA256、镜像来源和刷机后
   需补装的软件见 [固件交付说明](docs/firmware-2026-09-15.md)。
1. **编译 openvela 固件**
   ```bash
   # 先给公共仓 nuttx 打上 RK3576 芯片层补丁
   (cd nuttx && git am ../contest2026_290_dairoot/nuttx-side/*.patch)
   ./build.sh vendor/openvela/boards/contest2026_290_board/configs/nsh -j$(nproc)
   # 产物 nuttx/nuttx.bin，入口 0x41800000
   ```
2. **在 KickPi Linux SDK 上叠加 Linux 侧改动**（`board/contest_board/linux-side/`
   的 DTS / its / 分区表 / defconfig；这些与具体 RTOS 无关，一次性叠加即可）。
3. **打包烧写**：把 `nuttx.bin` 作为 amp 分区固件打进 `update.img` 烧录；后续只迭代
   openvela 时可只 `dd` 刷 amp 分区（约 10 秒）。
4. **验收**（Linux 终端）：
   ```bash
   cat /proc/device-tree/model            # ...KICKPI K7 Board (AMP)
   nproc                                   # 7
   sudo busybox devmem 0x47c00004          # 0x3  = openvela 心跳版本
   echo hello > /dev/ttyRPMSG0             # openvela 回显
   cat  /dev/ttyRPMSG0                     # -> hello
   # 离线唤醒（对板说「你好，openvela」，或 aplay 播放正样本）
   echo KWS_INFO > /dev/ttyRPMSG0 && head -1 /dev/ttyRPMSG0   # 引擎状态
   dmesg | grep 'wake word'                # snd_rpmsg_mic: p=0.9xx
   sudo python3 tools/kws/deploy/wake_watch.py                # KEY_WAKEUP 事件
   ```

## 五、关键技术难点（详见 board README 与提交历史）

| 难点 | 解决 |
|---|---|
| GICv2 被 Linux 独占 distributor | 新增 `CONFIG_ARM64_GIC_SLAVE`，openvela 不初始化 distributor，只碰自有中断位 |
| OpenAMP 静态资源表与 Rockchip 主控互通 | 逐一攻克 const 只读段 / 预设 DRIVER_OK / CPUNAME 特性 / config_len 等 5 处坑 |
| openvela 早于 Linux 启动的握手时序 | 信号量门控，先等 Linux 首个 kick（vring 就绪）再 announce |
| uart_rpmsg 私有帧协议与 Linux rpmsg_tty 裸字节不兼容 | 自建裸字节回显端点，wire-compatible |
| 板上无串口可读 | 发明 “RAMLOG + Linux devmem dump” 无串口调试法定位全部问题 |
| openvela 开源版无离线唤醒引擎（media_trigger 仅留接口） | 自研纯 C log-mel+DS-CNN 引擎：Python 训练管线与 C 实现同源查表、板上金标准对拍（|Δprob|<1e-7），常听于 cpu3，唤醒事件走 rpmsg 变成 Linux input 事件 |
| RKNN 不支持动态 shape，而语音长度天然可变 | 定长窗口导出 + 按帧对齐切段：窗口大小直接等于耗时（5 s 窗恒定 390 ms、10 s 窗 655 ms，选大了短句反而打不过 CPU）；长句最后一窗向前对齐成满窗、重叠部分按帧丢弃，不漏字不重复 |
| 3.8 GB 内存跑不动 936 MB fp32 权重 | 本地 ASR 全面转 int8 ONNX / RKNN fp16，加载峰值 2993 MB → 1300 MB，常驻 2.0 GB |

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Watch for wake-word events on the KickPi K7 Linux side.

The AMP slave's KWS engine reports detections as KEY_WAKEUP presses on the
"openvela-kws" input device (registered by snd_rpmsg_mic.ko).  This script
needs only the Python stdlib: it parses /proc/bus/input/devices to find the
event node and reads raw input_event structs from it.

Usage:  sudo python3 wake_watch.py [--exec CMD]

--exec CMD   run CMD (shell) on every wake, e.g. an aplay chime or the
             start of an ASR pipeline.
"""

import argparse
import struct
import subprocess
import sys
import time

EV_KEY = 0x01
KEY_WAKEUP = 143

# aarch64: struct input_event = struct timeval (16) + u16 type + u16 code
# + s32 value
EVFMT = "llHHi"
EVSIZE = struct.calcsize(EVFMT)


def find_event_node(name="openvela-kws"):
    dev = None
    with open("/proc/bus/input/devices") as f:
        block = []
        for line in f:
            if line.strip() == "":
                block = []
                continue
            block.append(line)
            if line.startswith("H:") and any(name in b for b in block):
                for tok in line.split():
                    if tok.startswith("event"):
                        return "/dev/input/" + tok
    return dev


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--exec", dest="cmd", default=None,
                    help="shell command to run on each wake")
    ap.add_argument("--device", default=None,
                    help="event node override, e.g. /dev/input/event3")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    node = args.device or find_event_node()
    if not node:
        print("openvela-kws input device not found — is snd_rpmsg_mic.ko "
              "loaded?", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

    print(f"listening on {node} (KEY_WAKEUP from the openvela KWS engine)",
          flush=True)
    n = 0
    with open(node, "rb", buffering=0) as f:
        while True:
            data = f.read(EVSIZE)
            if len(data) != EVSIZE:
                break
            _sec, _usec, etype, code, value = struct.unpack(EVFMT, data)
            if etype == EV_KEY and code == KEY_WAKEUP and value == 1:
                n += 1
                stamp = time.strftime("%H:%M:%S")
                print(f"[{stamp}] 你好，openvela!  wake #{n}", flush=True)
                if args.cmd:
                    subprocess.Popen(args.cmd, shell=True)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

[Unit]
Description=POST /api/restart on openvela wake-word detections
After=multi-user.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 -u /home/kickpi/wake_watch.py --exec "curl -s -m 3 -X POST -w \"restart POST -> %%{http_code}\\n\" http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/restart"
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
[Unit]
Description=Ding-dong feedback on openvela wake-word detections
After=multi-user.target sound.target

[Service]
Type=simple
# ding goes through the desktop user's PulseAudio so it mixes with whatever

# KickPi K7 的麦克风供电与 zram 服务

这两个单元用于本项目的 KickPi K7 / RK3576 Ubuntu AMP 系统：

| 单元 | 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| [kws-micpower.service](../../../tools/kws/deploy/kws-micpower.service) | 开机拉高 GPIO3_D0，为当前接在排针 pin 30 的麦克风供电 |
| [zram-swap.service](../../../board/contest_board/linux-side/rootfs/etc/systemd/system/zram-swap.service) | 直接使用内核内置的 zram0，配置 zstd、3 GiB、swap 优先级 100 |

文件来源：2026-09-19 从开发板的 `/etc/systemd/system/` 只读导出，两个服务均为
`enabled` / `active (exited)`，没有 drop-in；GPIO 读值为 `1`，zram 容量为
`3221225472` 字节、算法为 `[zstd]`、优先级为 `100`，发行版的
`zramswap.service` 为 `disabled` / `inactive`。入仓的麦克风单元与板上文件一致；
zram 单元仅将 shell 参数从 `-c` 改为 `-ec`，确保配置或 `swapoff` 失败时立即停止，
不继续执行格式化或 reset。这次只完成配置读取与静态检查，未替换板上服务、重启或烧写。

[已发布整包](../../../docs/firmware-2026-09-15.md)使用厂商预制 rootfs，**不包含
这两个单元**。仓库中的 `rootfs/etc/` 是待安装配置，不能据此认为它已进入 Release 镜像。

## 安装前核对

- 麦克风单元只适用于本项目的 **pin 30 / GPIO3_D0** 应急供电接法，先按
  [接线说明](../../../board/contest_board/docs/k7-40pin-pinout.md)确认。使用独立
  1.8V LDO 供电时不需要此单元，也不要同时连接 GPIO 电源。
- zram 单元要求 `/sys/block/zram0/` 已由内核提供、支持 `zstd`，且板上有
  `mkswap`、`swapon`、`swapoff`（Ubuntu 的 `util-linux`）。它不调用 `modprobe`。
- 不要让 `zramswap.service`、zram generator 或 `/etc/fstab` 同时管理 zram0。
  正在使用 swap 时不要直接重启服务或 reset 设备；先停掉推理负载，并确认可用内存
  足够容纳换出的页面。仅补交仓库文件时无需操作运行中的板子。

在**开发板**上检查：

```bash
cat /sys/class/leds/GPIO3_D0/brightness
cat /sys/block/zram0/comp_algorithm
cat /sys/block/zram0/disksize
swapon --show
systemctl status kws-micpower.service zram-swap.service zramswap.service --no-pager
```

# ASR WebSocket 服务（Linux 侧语音识别 + 声纹）

RK3576 上 Linux 侧的语音链路，接在 openvela 侧的离线唤醒之后：cpu3 上的 openvela
常听「你好，openvela」，唤醒后由本服务在 Linux 的 7 个核 + NPU 上做实时识别与说话人
辨认。唤醒那一半见 [`../../tools/kws/`](../../tools/kws/) 和
[`../../board/contest_board/`](../../board/contest_board/)。

`server.py` 把 `asr_client.AsrClient` 公开为 WebSocket 服务，每条连接拥有独立的
VAD、ASR 和说话人状态。**ASR 与声纹两个模型都跑在 RK3576 的 6 TOPS NPU 上**，
实测见下面的「NPU（RK3576）」一节。

## 目录结构

以下模块位于本目录（`linux-apps/asr-server/`），以本目录为工作目录运行：

```
asr_client.py         # AsrClient：音频分块、VAD 驱动、快/慢回复策略
server.py             # WebSocket + HTTP 服务入口
config.py             # 后端选择与模型路径（读 .env）
vad.py                # FSMN VAD（PyTorch，跑 CPU）
speaker.py            # 说话人匹配（centroid）+ 后端分流
speaker_rknn.py       # 声纹 NPU 后端
voiceprint_store.py   # asr_wsv2 调试页的具名声纹存储
event_emitter.py      # 极简异步事件总线
asr_model/            # sense_voice（int8 ONNX / RKNN NPU）、volc 三种识别后端
utils/                # 批处理、设备探测、模型缓存路径
tools/                # 模型导出与 RKNN 转换（只在开发机/转换机跑）
tests/                # 单元测试 + 浏览器调试页
```

## 启动

与摄像头、harness 配套运行时，见总 README 的
[三个服务启动说明](../../README.md#linux-app-服务启动)。以下命令在本目录执行。

依赖由 [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) 管理，声明在 `pyproject.toml`，锁定在
`uv.lock`。`uv sync` 会按 `.python-version`（3.11）自动准备解释器并创建 `.venv`：

```bash
uv sync
uv run server.py
```

`uv run` 会在执行前校验环境与锁文件是否一致，不需要手动 `activate`。
增删依赖用 `uv add <包>` / `uv remove <包>`（会同步更新 `pyproject.toml` 和
`uv.lock`），升级用 `uv lock --upgrade-package <包>`。

同一份 `uv.lock` 覆盖开发机（macOS，torch 走 MPS）和 ARM64 Linux 部署环境。
PyPI 上 torch 的 Linux wheel 不分架构地依赖 CUDA 全家桶，而部署环境没有 N 卡，
所以 `pyproject.toml` 把 Linux 侧的 `torch` / `torchaudio` 指到官方 CPU 源取同版本的
`+cpu` 构建，`uv sync` 在部署环境上不会拉 NVIDIA 包。CPU 源的 wheel 是
`manylinux_2_28`，要求 glibc ≥ 2.28（Debian 10+ / Ubuntu 20.04+）。改动依赖后可以
在开发机上先验证部署侧的解析结果：

```bash
uv sync --frozen --dry-run --python-platform aarch64-manylinux_2_28
```

默认监听 `0.0.0.0:8086`，识别后端由 `ASR_MODEL_TYPE` 决定（见下节，板子上用
`sense_voice_rknn` 走 NPU）。需要改监听地址、端口或后端时，可在 Python 中调用

text:
现在的 harness 已经有了“语音对话 + 工具 + 技能 + 长期记忆”的骨架。要算一个完整的终端 harness，还缺五块：语音打断和跨会话续聊、出错和断网时的兜底、权限与安全、主动能力（定时、提醒、事件），以及文本模式、评测和部署。下面按优先级列出，都是读代码得出的，没改文件，也没上板验证。

> 我把“终端”理解成跑在 K7 板子上的 agent harness。如果你指的是命令行界面，主要看第 9 条。

**已有的：** 麦克风 → 本地 ASR（NPU，带声纹）→ 云端 LLM 流式输出 → 云端 TTS。唤醒词通过 `kws-restart-hook.service` 调 `/api/restart`。工具有 MCP（米家、摄像头、音量、fetch）和 SDK 自带的工具（天气、搜索、点歌、`exec_command`、`read_skills`）。另外有技能安装与开关、超过 24k token 自动压缩上下文、每小时整理一次的日记和 2000 字长期记忆。

### P0：每天都会碰到的

1. **唤醒词等于重启，会话中途唤醒会清空上下文。** hook 不看当前状态，直接 POST `/api/restart`（[kws-restart-hook.service](tools/kws/deploy/kws-restart-hook.service)），`restart()` 会关掉旧 ChatBot 再新建一个（[main.py:608](linux-apps/harness/main.py:608)）。
   - 缺一个真正的“唤醒”逻辑：正在说话就打断（SDK 已有 `ChatBot.abort()`），会话还开着就接着听，会话已结束才开新的。
   - 叮声由另一个服务单独播放，跟 harness 重启不同步，重启期间说的话会丢掉。
2. **不能用语音打断。** 播放期间麦克风数据直接丢弃（[main.py:863](linux-apps/harness/main.py:863)）。
   - 便宜的做法：把唤醒词当打断键，openvela 那颗麦一直在听。
   - 想边说边插话，就得加回声消除（AEC），工作量大很多。
3. **跨会话接不上话。** 空闲 60 秒会话就结束（写死在 SDK 里），下次唤醒是全新的上下文，只剩每小时整理一次的长期记忆。比如问完“今天天气”，过两分钟再问“那明天呢”，它就接不上。缺的是：几分钟内开的新会话能带上上一轮的消息或摘要。
4. **出错不出声，断网就哑。**
   - LLM 或 TTS 运行中出错只写日志；页面的 `last_error` 只在启动时设置，运行中的错误也看不到。
   - 默认的 LLM 接口和四个 TTS 引擎都要联网。
   - 缺本地 TTS 或预录提示音兜底，运行中的错误也要能显示在页面上。

### P1：harness 的核心能力

5. **权限与安全基本是空白。**
   - `exec_command` 用 `shell=True` 执行，没有白名单也没有确认，只靠提示词约束。它是 SDK 内置的工具，一个技能都不启用也照样提供给模型，配置台关不掉。fetch 和搜索会把网页内容带进上下文，网页里藏的指令有可能诱导它执行命令。
   - 配置台没有鉴权，监听 0.0.0.0（[main.py:67](linux-apps/harness/main.py:67)），能改 MCP 启动命令、跑安装命令。同网段的人等于能在板子上执行任意命令。
   - 声纹只用来称呼人，不参与授权：开关设备、执行命令，谁说都行，电视里的声音也行。
   - 缺的是：工具按风险分级、危险操作用语音二次确认、按说话人授权、配置台登录。
6. **没有主动能力。**
   - 没有定时、闹钟、提醒工具，也没有到点让它主动开口的调度。
   - SDK 的 `send_tts_text` 能直接播报，但 harness 没有开放调用入口。
   - YOLO 只在画面上画框，miloco-server 没有检测结果接口，做不了“有人进门提醒我”。
7. **模型自己管不了记忆。** 记忆是会话开始时整段塞进提示词的一段文本，每小时更新一次。模型没有“记一下”或“查以前聊过什么”的工具，历史记录只能人在 `/history` 页面看。
8. **长任务跑不了。**
   - 单个工具最长 20 秒（[main.py:60](linux-apps/harness/main.py:60)），`exec_command` 自己还有 8 秒超时。
   - 一次回复最多 5 轮工具调用（写死在 SDK 里）；超了会递归再来一轮，没有总上限。
   - 缺后台任务，以及任务做完后主动播报结果。

### P2：工程化

9. **没有文本 / 命令行模式。**
   - 启动时就打开扬声器（[main.py:872](linux-apps/harness/main.py:872)），没有声卡起不来。
   - 网页上打字也会走 TTS 念出来，也没有命令行入口。
   - 缺不连声卡和 TTS 的纯文本模式，以及终端里的交互界面：流式输出、显示工具调用、在终端确认危险操作、恢复上次会话。这也是做自动化评测的前提。
10. **没有评测集。** 现有测试都是用模拟对象测单个组件。缺的是检查 agent 行为的回归用例：给一句话，看它有没有调对工具、回复是否在 60 字以内、有没有 Markdown。
11. **可观测性不全。** 已记录 token 用量和首个 token 的延迟。缺“用户说完到听见第一声”的端到端延迟，也缺每轮对话的调用记录。
12. **部署靠手动。** 三个服务都要手动在前台启动，仓库里没有对应的 systemd 配置，崩溃后不会自动拉起。
13. **零碎缺口：**
    - 米家 MCP 只有开关。miloco-server 已有读状态的 `GET /device/power`（[web.py:326](linux-apps/miloco-server/web.py:326)），但没做成工具。
    - 技能只能开关，不能卸载。
    - MCP 工具返回的图片会被 SDK 丢掉。
    - 空闲时长、工具调用次数、压缩阈值都不能配置。

### 改在哪

- **只改 harness（加上 miloco 和部署脚本）就行：** 第 1、3、6、7、9、10、12 条，外加配置台登录、米家读状态、技能卸载。文本模式可以直接用 SDK 的 `LlmAgent`，它不依赖 TTS 和 ASR。
- **要改 aichat-sdk 再发版：** 回声消除、本地 TTS、`exec_command` 的管控和按说话人授权、长任务、工具返回图片、写死的常量。

建议先做第 1 和第 3 条：只动 harness，改动小，日常体验提升最明显。然后做第 5 条的权限层，再做第 6 条的提醒和主动播报。

323	async def update(path: str, *, timezone: float, soul: str = "", llm=None) -> dict:
324	    """整理还没写进日记的会话，返回本轮更新的日期、整理的会话数、剩余和被模型拒绝的会话数。
325	
326	    每块提交后才算整理完成；中途出错时已提交的保留，其余留到下一轮。
327	    """
328	    llm = llm or complete
329	    summary = {"dates": [], "sessions": 0, "pending": 0, "skipped": 0}
330	    if not Path(path).exists():
331	        return summary
332	    tz = datetime.timezone(datetime.timedelta(hours=timezone))
333	    empty, chunks = await asyncio.to_thread(_load_pending, path, tz)
334	    if empty:
335	        await asyncio.to_thread(_mark_empty, path, empty)
336	        summary["sessions"] += len(empty)
337	    for index, chunk in enumerate(chunks):
338	        if index >= MAX_CHUNKS_PER_ROUND:
339	            summary["pending"] += sum(len(rest["session_ids"]) for rest in chunks[index:])
340	            break
341	        count = len(chunk["session_ids"])
342	        memory, token, old_diary = await asyncio.to_thread(_load_context, path, chunk["date"])
343	        try:
344	            diary_output, memory_output = await asyncio.gather(
345	                llm(_diary_prompt(soul), _diary_input(chunk["date"], old_diary, chunk["transcript"])),
346	                llm(MEMORY_PROMPT, _memory_input(chunk["date"], memory, chunk["transcript"])),
347	            )
348	        except BadRequestError:
349	            # 例如内容审核拒绝：这块留到下一轮重试，不挡住后面的会话，也不标为已整理。
350	            logger.warning("[diary] 模型拒绝整理 %s 的 %d 个会话，留到下一轮", chunk["date"], count)
351	            summary["skipped"] += count
352	            summary["pending"] += count
353	            continue
354	        committed = await asyncio.to_thread(
355	            _commit, path, chunk, _diary_text(diary_output), _memory_text(memory_output, memory), token,
356	        )
357	        if not committed:
358	            logger.info("[diary] 整理期间数据有变动，剩余会话留到下一轮")
359	            summary["pending"] += sum(len(rest["session_ids"]) for rest in chunks[index:])
360	            break
361	        summary["sessions"] += count
362	        if chunk["date"] not in summary["dates"]:
363	            summary["dates"].append(chunk["date"])
364	        logger.info("[diary] 已整理 %s 的 %d 个会话", chunk["date"], count)
365	    return summary

44	def _content_object(content) -> dict:
45	    """读取 content 中的 JSON 对象，纯文本及其他结构返回空对象。"""
46	    if isinstance(content, str):
47	        try:
48	            content = json.loads(content)
49	        except ValueError:
50	            return {}
51	    return content if isinstance(content, dict) else {}

54	def _serialize_content(content, *, role: str | None = None) -> str | None:
55	    """用户消息提取 text；其他正文保留原值，结构化内容序列化为 JSON。"""
56	    if role == "user":
57	        text = _content_object(content).get("text")
58	        if isinstance(text, str):
59	            return text
60	    if content is None or isinstance(content, str):
61	        return content
62	    return json.dumps(content, ensure_ascii=False, default=str)

65	def _message_metadata(message) -> dict[str, str | None]:
66	    """优先取消息的时间和说话人，缺失时从 content JSON 对象提取，不改写正文。"""
67	    content = _content_object(message.get("content"))
68	    metadata = {}
69	    for field in ("time", "speaker"):
70	        metadata[field] = None
71	        for source in (message, content):
72	            value = source.get(field)
73	            if field == "time" and isinstance(value, datetime.datetime):
74	                value = value.isoformat()
75	            if isinstance(value, str) and value:
76	                metadata[field] = value
77	                break
78	    return metadata

83	    content = "".join(json.dumps(message, ensure_ascii=False, default=str) + "\n" for message in messages)

89	@contextmanager
90	def _write_database(path: str):
91	    """写事务：按需建目录和当前全部表，BEGIN IMMEDIATE 开始即持有写锁；正常退出提交，异常回滚。"""
92	    Path(path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
93	    engine = create_engine(
94	        URL.create("sqlite+pysqlite", database=path),
95	        json_serializer=lambda value: json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, default=str),
96	    )
97	
98	    @event.listens_for(engine, "connect")
99	    def connect(dbapi_connection, connection_record):
100	        # BEGIN 交给下面的 begin 事件发出；PRAGMA 要在事务外执行。
101	        dbapi_connection.isolation_level = None
102	        with closing(dbapi_connection.cursor()) as cursor:
103	            cursor.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
104	
105	    @event.listens_for(engine, "begin")
106	    def begin(connection):
107	        # pysqlite 默认到第一条写语句才开事务，先读后写的检查会被其他写入插队。
108	        connection.exec_driver_sql("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
109	
110	    try:
111	        Base.metadata.create_all(engine)
112	        with Session(engine) as session, session.begin():
113	            yield session
114	    finally:
115	        engine.dispose()

118	@contextmanager
119	def _read_database(path: str):
120	    """查询使用只读连接；尚未保存过会话时不创建数据库或目录。"""
121	    database = Path(path).resolve()
122	    if not database.exists():
123	        yield None
124	        return
125	    engine = create_engine(URL.create(
126	        "sqlite+pysqlite", database=database.as_uri(), query={"mode": "ro", "uri": "true"},
127	    ))
128	    try:
129	        with Session(engine) as session:
130	            yield session
131	    finally:
132	        engine.dispose()

135	def query_sessions(
136	    path: str, *, query: str = "", date: str = "", timezone: float = 8, limit: int = 20, offset: int = 0,
137	) -> dict:
138	    """按会话 ID、消息内容和配置时区的开始日期筛选，返回最近开始的会话摘要。"""
139	    result = {"sessions": [], "total": 0, "limit": limit, "offset": offset}
140	    with _read_database(path) as session:
141	        if session is None:
142	            return result
143	        filters = []
144	        if date:
145	            start = datetime.datetime.combine(
146	                datetime.date.fromisoformat(date), datetime.time.min,
147	                tzinfo=datetime.timezone(datetime.timedelta(hours=timezone)),
148	            )
149	            start_day = func.julianday(start.isoformat())
150	            session_day = func.julianday(func.datetime(ChatSession.started_at))
151	            filters.extend((session_day >= start_day, session_day < start_day + 1))
152	        if query:
153	            filters.append(or_(
154	                ChatSession.id.contains(query, autoescape=True),
155	                ChatSession.messages.any(ChatMessage.content.contains(query, autoescape=True)),
156	            ))
157	        result["total"] = session.scalar(select(func.count()).select_from(ChatSession).where(*filters))
158	        message_count = select(func.count()).where(ChatMessage.session_id == ChatSession.id).scalar_subquery()
159	        first_user_content = (
160	            select(ChatMessage.content)
161	            .where(ChatMessage.session_id == ChatSession.id, ChatMessage.role == "user")
162	            .order_by(ChatMessage.position).limit(1).scalar_subquery()
163	        )
164	        rows = session.execute(
165	            select(ChatSession.id, ChatSession.started_at, ChatSession.ended_at,
166	                   message_count.label("message_count"), first_user_content.label("preview"))
167	            .where(*filters).order_by(ChatSession.started_at.desc(), ChatSession.id.desc())
168	            .limit(limit).offset(offset)
169	        ).mappings()
170	        result["sessions"] = [{**row, "preview": (row["preview"] or "")[:160]} for row in rows]
171	    return result

178	        if record is None:

180	        return {
181	            "id": record.id, "started_at": record.started_at, "ended_at": record.ended_at,
182	            "messages": [
183	                {"position": message.position, "role": message.role, "speaker": message.speaker, "time": message.time,

104	def _local_time(value: str | None, tz: datetime.tzinfo) -> datetime.datetime | None:
105	    """带偏移的 ISO 时间换到配置时区，无偏移的视为本地时间；无法解析返回 None。"""
106	    try:
107	        moment = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(value)
108	    except (TypeError, ValueError):
109	        return None
110	    return moment.astimezone(tz) if moment.tzinfo else moment.replace(tzinfo=tz)

113	def _clip(text: str, limit: int) -> str:
114	    text = " ".join(text.split())
115	    return text if len(text) <= limit else text[:limit] + "…"
116

118	def _fit(lines: list[str], limit: int) -> list[str]:
119	    """超出预算时保留开头和结尾各约一半，中间标注省略。"""
120	    if sum(len(line) + 1 for line in lines) <= limit:
121	        return lines
122	    budget = limit // 2
123	    head, size = [], 0
124	    for line in lines:
125	        if size + len(line) + 1 > budget:
126	            break
127	        head.append(line)
128	        size += len(line) + 1
129	    tail, size = [], 0
130	    for line in reversed(lines[len(head):]):
131	        if size + len(line) + 1 > budget:
132	            break
133	        tail.append(line)
134	        size += len(line) + 1
135	    return [*head, "……（中间省略）……", *reversed(tail)]

138	def render_session(session: dict, tz: datetime.tzinfo) -> str:
139	    """一场会话的转写：会话头加每行「HH:MM 名字：内容」；没有用户发言时返回空串。"""
140	    lines = []
141	    has_user = False
142	    for message in session["messages"]:
143	        role, content = message["role"], (message["content"] or "").strip()
144	        # 工具结果不入转写；SDK 的道别、工具收尾等内部用户消息正文为空，一并跳过。
145	        if role not in ("user", "assistant") or not content:
146	            continue
147	        has_user = has_user or role == "user"
148	        moment = _local_time(message["time"], tz)
149	        prefix = f"{moment:%H:%M} " if moment else ""
150	        name = speaker_label(message["speaker"]) if role == "user" else "助手"
151	        lines.append(f"{prefix}{name}：{_clip(content, MESSAGE_CHARS)}")
152	    if not has_user:
153	        return ""
154	    start = _local_time(session["started_at"], tz)
155	    header = f"【{start:%H:%M} 开始的对话】" if start else "【一段对话】"
156	    return "\n".join([header, *_fit(lines, CHUNK_CHARS - len(header) - 1)])

159	def _session_date(session: dict, tz: datetime.tzinfo) -> str:
160	    moment = _local_time(session["started_at"], tz) or _local_time(session["ended_at"], tz)
161	    return (moment or datetime.datetime.now(tz)).date().isoformat()

166	def _load_pending(path: str, tz: datetime.tzinfo) -> tuple[list[str], list[dict]]:
167	    """补建表后读出还没有整理标记的会话：没有用户发言的单独列出，其余按本地日期升序切块。"""
168	    with _write_database(path) as session:  # 旧数据库在这里补建日记相关的表
169	        records = session.scalars(
170	            select(ChatSession)
171	            .where(~select(DiarySession.session_id).where(DiarySession.session_id == ChatSession.id).exists())
172	            .options(selectinload(ChatSession.messages))
173	            .order_by(ChatSession.started_at, ChatSession.id)
174	        ).all()
175	        sessions = [
176	            {
177	                "id": record.id, "started_at": record.started_at, "ended_at": record.ended_at,
178	                "messages": [
179	                    {"role": message.role, "speaker": message.speaker, "time": message.time, "content": message.content}
180	                    for message in record.messages
181	                ],
182	            }
183	            for record in records
184	        ]
185	    empty, chunks = [], []
186	    for item in sessions:
187	        transcript = render_session(item, tz)
188	        if not transcript:
189	            empty.append(item["id"])
190	            continue
191	        date = _session_date(item, tz)
192	        last = chunks[-1] if chunks else None
193	        if last and last["date"] == date and len(last["transcript"]) + len(transcript) + 2 <= CHUNK_CHARS:
194	            last["session_ids"].append(item["id"])
195	            last["transcript"] += "\n\n" + transcript
196	        else:
197	            chunks.append({"date": date, "session_ids": [item["id"]], "transcript": transcript})
198	    return empty, chunks

220	def _commit(path: str, chunk: dict, diary: str, memory: str | None, token: str | None) -> bool:
221	    """同一事务写日记、记忆和整理标记；期间数据被改动则回滚并返回 False。"""
222	    now = _utc_now()
223	    try:
224	        with _write_database(path) as session:
225	            ids = chunk["session_ids"]
226	            if session.scalar(select(func.count()).select_from(DiarySession).where(DiarySession.session_id.in_(ids))):
227	                raise _Conflict  # 另一个进程（例如手动运行的 diary.py）已经整理过
228	            if memory is not None:
229	                current = session.get(Memory, 1)
230	                if (current.updated_at if current else None) != token:
231	                    raise _Conflict  # 页面刚改过记忆，下一轮以它为准重新整理
232	                session.merge(Memory(id=1, content=memory, source="diary", updated_at=now))
233	            session.merge(DiaryEntry(date=chunk["date"], content=diary, updated_at=now))
234	            session.add_all(DiarySession(session_id=session_id, date=chunk["date"]) for session_id in ids)
235	    except _Conflict:
236	        return False
237	    return True

291	def _diary_text(output: str) -> str:
292	    text = _clean(output)
293	    if not text:
294	        raise ValueError("模型返回的日记为空")
295	    if len(text) <= DIARY_LIMIT:
296	        return text
297	    head = text[:DIARY_LIMIT]
298	    cut = max(head.rfind(mark) for mark in "。！？!?\n")
299	    return head[:cut + 1].rstrip() if cut > 0 else head

302	def _memory_text(output: str, old: str) -> str | None:
303	    """要写入的新记忆；None 表示保持原样。"""
304	    text = _clean(output)
305	    if text in ("", *EMPTY_MEMORY):
306	        if old:
307	            logger.warning("[diary] 模型返回空记忆，保留原有记忆")
308	        return None
309	    if len(text) > MEMORY_LIMIT:
310	        logger.warning("[diary] 记忆超过 %d 字，按整行截断", MEMORY_LIMIT)
311	        kept, size = [], 0
312	        for line in text.splitlines():
313	            if size + len(line) > MEMORY_LIMIT:
314	                break
315	            kept.append(line)
316	            size += len(line) + 1
317	        text = "\n".join(kept).strip() or text[:MEMORY_LIMIT]
318	    return None if text == old else text

323	async def update(path: str, *, timezone: float, soul: str = "", llm=None) -> dict:
324	    """整理还没写进日记的会话，返回本轮更新的日期、整理的会话数、剩余和被模型拒绝的会话数。
325	
326	    每块提交后才算整理完成；中途出错时已提交的保留，其余留到下一轮。
327	    """
328	    llm = llm or complete
329	    summary = {"dates": [], "sessions": 0, "pending": 0, "skipped": 0}
330	    if not Path(path).exists():
331	        return summary
332	    tz = datetime.timezone(datetime.timedelta(hours=timezone))
333	    empty, chunks = await asyncio.to_thread(_load_pending, path, tz)
334	    if empty:
335	        await asyncio.to_thread(_mark_empty, path, empty)
336	        summary["sessions"] += len(empty)
337	    for index, chunk in enumerate(chunks):
338	        if index >= MAX_CHUNKS_PER_ROUND:
339	            summary["pending"] += sum(len(rest["session_ids"]) for rest in chunks[index:])
340	            break
341	        count = len(chunk["session_ids"])
342	        memory, token, old_diary = await asyncio.to_thread(_load_context, path, chunk["date"])
343	        try:
344	            diary_output, memory_output = await asyncio.gather(
345	                llm(_diary_prompt(soul), _diary_input(chunk["date"], old_diary, chunk["transcript"])),
346	                llm(MEMORY_PROMPT, _memory_input(chunk["date"], memory, chunk["transcript"])),
347	            )
348	        except BadRequestError:
349	            # 例如内容审核拒绝：这块留到下一轮重试，不挡住后面的会话，也不标为已整理。
350	            logger.warning("[diary] 模型拒绝整理 %s 的 %d 个会话，留到下一轮", chunk["date"], count)
351	            summary["skipped"] += count
352	            summary["pending"] += count
353	            continue
354	        committed = await asyncio.to_thread(
355	            _commit, path, chunk, _diary_text(diary_output), _memory_text(memory_output, memory), token,
356	        )
357	        if not committed:
358	            logger.info("[diary] 整理期间数据有变动，剩余会话留到下一轮")
359	            summary["pending"] += sum(len(rest["session_ids"]) for rest in chunks[index:])
360	            break
361	        summary["sessions"] += count
362	        if chunk["date"] not in summary["dates"]:
363	            summary["dates"].append(chunk["date"])
364	        logger.info("[diary] 已整理 %s 的 %d 个会话", chunk["date"], count)
365	    return summary

397	def list_diaries(path: str, month: str) -> dict:
398	    """某个月（YYYY-MM）的日记，按日期升序，附当天整理进日记的会话数；first / last 是全部日记的日期范围。"""
399	    result = {"month": month, "diaries": [], "first": "", "last": ""}
400	    with _read_database(path) as session:
401	        if session is None or not _has_tables(session, DiaryEntry.__tablename__, DiarySession.__tablename__):
402	            return result
403	        first, last = session.execute(select(func.min(DiaryEntry.date), func.max(DiaryEntry.date))).one()
404	        result["first"], result["last"] = first or "", last or ""
405	        session_count = select(func.count()).where(DiarySession.date == DiaryEntry.date).scalar_subquery()
406	        rows = session.execute(
407	            select(DiaryEntry.date, DiaryEntry.content, DiaryEntry.updated_at, session_count.label("session_count"))
408	            .where(DiaryEntry.date.startswith(f"{month}-", autoescape=True))
409	            .order_by(DiaryEntry.date)
410	        ).mappings()
411	        result["diaries"] = [dict(row) for row in rows]
412	    return result

EVENTS_SCOPE = {

    "method": "GET", "path": "/api/events", "query_string": b"", "root_path": "",
    "headers": [(b"host", b"testserver")],
}


class FakeClient:
    """只实现 web 层用到的那几个方法；messages() 跟 AIClient 一样返回会话里那个 list 本身。"""

    def __init__(self):
        self.msgs = [{"role": "system", "content": "很长的系统提示词"}]
        self.round = 0

    def live_status(self) -> dict:
        return {"running": True, "round": self.round}

    def status(self) -> dict:
        return {**self.live_status(), "tts_engine": "bytedancev1", "mcp": [], "skills": [], "skills_dir": "/skills"}

    def messages(self) -> list[dict]:
        return self.msgs


class StateEventsTest(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.client = FakeClient()
        interval = patch.object(server, "EVENT_INTERVAL", 0.01)  # 别让测试等在 0.5 秒的轮子上
        interval.start()
        self.addCleanup(interval.stop)

    async def frames(self, count: int, act=None) -> list[dict]:
        """收 count 帧就断开；act 在第一帧之后调用，用来制造下一帧。"""
        collected: list[dict] = []
        closed = asyncio.Event()

        async def receive() -> dict:
            await closed.wait()  # 页面关掉，服务端那个 while 才收得住
            return {"type": "http.disconnect"}

        async def send(message: dict) -> None:
            if message["type"] != "http.response.body":
                return
            for line in message["body"].decode().splitlines():
                if line.startswith("data: "):
                    collected.append(json.loads(line[len("data: "):]))
            if len(collected) == 1 and act:
                act()
            if len(collected) >= count:
                closed.set()

        await asyncio.wait_for(create_app(self.client)(EVENTS_SCOPE, receive, send), timeout=5)
        self.assertEqual(len(collected), count)
        return collected

    async def test_state_is_full_and_events_carry_only_live_status(self):
        with TestClient(create_app(self.client)) as web:
            state = web.get("/api/state").json()
        self.assertEqual(state["status"], self.client.status())
        self.assertEqual(state["messages"], self.client.msgs)
        # 只在重启 / 保存配置后才变的那几项不该每帧重发
        frame = (await self.frames(1))[0]
        self.assertEqual(frame["status"], self.client.live_status())

    async def test_first_frame_carries_all_messages_then_only_new_ones(self):
        first, second = await self.frames(2, act=lambda: self.client.msgs.append({"role": "user", "content": "你好"}))
        self.assertEqual((first["start"], first["messages"]), (0, self.client.msgs[:1]))
        self.assertEqual((second["start"], second["messages"]), (1, self.client.msgs[1:]))

    async def test_new_session_resends_everything_from_zero(self):
        def restart():
            self.client.msgs = [{"role": "system", "content": "新会话"}]  # 重启换了 ChatBot，messages 是新 list
            self.client.round = 1

        first, second = await self.frames(2, act=restart)
        self.assertEqual(first["start"], 0)
        self.assertEqual((second["start"], second["messages"]), (0, self.client.msgs))
        self.assertEqual(second["status"]["round"], 1)

    async def _schedule_loop(self) -> None:
        """睡到最近一次执行时间再执行到点的任务；任务有改动或要手动运行时立即重算。

        只有这一个任务执行定时任务，执行不会重叠；执行完马上重算下一次。
        """
        while True:
            self._schedule_wakeup.clear()
            delay = SCHEDULE_MAX_SLEEP
            try:
                now, tz = self._schedule_clock()
                due, wake_at = await asyncio.to_thread(schedules.collect_due, SESSION_DB_PATH, now=now, tz=tz)
                runs: list[tuple[dict, datetime.datetime | None]] = list(due)
                manual, self._manual_runs = self._manual_runs, []
                for task_id in manual:
                    task = await asyncio.to_thread(schedules.get_task, SESSION_DB_PATH, task_id, now=now, tz=tz)
                    if task is not None and all(task["id"] != item["id"] for item, _ in runs):
                        runs.append((task, None))  # None：手动运行，按实际运行时刻记录
                if self.schedule_state["error"]:
                    self.schedule_state = {**self.schedule_state, "error": ""}
                if runs:
                    await self._run_scheduled(runs)
                    continue
                if wake_at is not None:
                    left = (wake_at - datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)).total_seconds()
                    delay = min(delay, max(0.0, left))
            except (OSError, SQLAlchemyError, ValueError, TypeError):
                logger.exception("定时任务调度失败")
                self.schedule_state = {**self.schedule_state, "error": "定时任务读取或保存失败，详见服务日志"}
            try:
                await asyncio.wait_for(self._schedule_wakeup.wait(), delay)
            except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                pass

    async def _wait_until_idle(self, timeout: float) -> None:
        """等当前这一轮对话说完（最多 timeout 秒），免得定时任务插在用户和助手中间。"""
        loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
        deadline = loop.time() + timeout
        while (self.is_restarting or self.is_playing or self._text_tasks) and loop.time() < deadline:
            await asyncio.sleep(0.5)

    async def _run_scheduled(self, runs: list[tuple[dict, datetime.datetime | None]]) -> None:
        """让助手执行到点（或手动运行）的任务：同一时刻的合成一条消息，会话已结束就开一轮新会话。

        先记下执行时间再交给 ChatBot：记录写不进去就不执行，同一次不会重复播报。
        """
        await self._wait_until_idle(SCHEDULE_IDLE_WAIT)
        started = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
        marks = [(task["id"], occurrence or started) for task, occurrence in runs]
        await asyncio.to_thread(schedules.mark_runs, SESSION_DB_PATH, marks, status="done")
        names = "、".join(task["title"] or task["prompt"][:20] for task, _ in runs)
        error = ""
        try:
            if self.chat_bot is None or self.is_session_closed:
                await self.restart()  # 跟唤醒词一样开一轮新会话，说完用户还能接着回话
            chat_bot = self.chat_bot
            if chat_bot is None:
                error = self.last_error or "对话服务没有运行"
            else:
                self._start_text_task(chat_bot.send_text(

                    response_instructions=schedules.TRIGGER_INSTRUCTIONS,
                ))
                logger.info("[schedule] 执行定时任务：%s", names)
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("执行定时任务失败")
            error = "执行失败，详见服务日志"
        if error:

    async def _schedule_loop(self) -> None:
        """睡到最近一次执行时间再执行到点的任务；任务有改动或要手动运行时立即重算。

        只有这一个任务执行定时任务，执行不会重叠；执行完马上重算下一次。
        """
        while True:
            self._schedule_wakeup.clear()
            delay = SCHEDULE_MAX_SLEEP
            try:
                now, tz = self._schedule_clock()
                due, wake_at = await asyncio.to_thread(schedules.collect_due, SESSION_DB_PATH, now=now, tz=tz)
                runs: list[tuple[dict, datetime.datetime | None]] = list(due)
                manual, self._manual_runs = self._manual_runs, []
                for task_id in manual:
                    task = await asyncio.to_thread(schedules.get_task, SESSION_DB_PATH, task_id, now=now, tz=tz)
                    if task is not None and all(task["id"] != item["id"] for item, _ in runs):
                        runs.append((task, None))  # None：手动运行，按实际运行时刻记录
                if self.schedule_state["error"]:
                    self.schedule_state = {**self.schedule_state, "error": ""}
                if runs:
                    await self._run_scheduled(runs)
                    continue
                if wake_at is not None:
                    left = (wake_at - datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)).total_seconds()
                    delay = min(delay, max(0.0, left))
            except (OSError, SQLAlchemyError, ValueError, TypeError):
                logger.exception("定时任务调度失败")
                self.schedule_state = {**self.schedule_state, "error": "定时任务读取或保存失败，详见服务日志"}
            try:
                await asyncio.wait_for(self._schedule_wakeup.wait(), delay)
            except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                pass

    async def _wait_until_idle(self, timeout: float) -> None:
        """等当前这一轮对话说完（最多 timeout 秒），免得定时任务插在用户和助手中间。"""
        loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
        deadline = loop.time() + timeout
        while (self.is_restarting or self.is_playing or self._text_tasks) and loop.time() < deadline:
            await asyncio.sleep(0.5)

    async def _run_scheduled(self, runs: list[tuple[dict, datetime.datetime | None]]) -> None:
        """让助手执行到点（或手动运行）的任务：同一时刻的合成一条消息，会话已结束就开一轮新会话。

        先记下执行时间再交给 ChatBot：记录写不进去就不执行，同一次不会重复播报。
        """
        await self._wait_until_idle(SCHEDULE_IDLE_WAIT)
        started = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
        marks = [(task["id"], occurrence or started) for task, occurrence in runs]
        await asyncio.to_thread(schedules.mark_runs, SESSION_DB_PATH, marks, status="done")
        names = "、".join(task["title"] or task["prompt"][:20] for task, _ in runs)
        error = ""
        try:
            if self.chat_bot is None or self.is_session_closed:
                await self.restart()  # 跟唤醒词一样开一轮新会话，说完用户还能接着回话
            chat_bot = self.chat_bot
            if chat_bot is None:
                error = self.last_error or "对话服务没有运行"
            else:

                    schedules.trigger_text([task for task, _ in runs]),
                    response_instructions=schedules.TRIGGER_INSTRUCTIONS,
                ))
                logger.info("[schedule] 执行定时任务：%s", names)
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("执行定时任务失败")
            error = "执行失败，详见服务日志"

            logger.error("[schedule] 定时任务没能执行（%s）：%s", names, error)
            try:

"""定时任务回归：临时 SQLite + 模拟 ChatBot，不访问音频、网络或真实模型。

MCP 测试把 schedule_mcp 发往 harness 的请求转给 TestClient，走真实的接口、校验和数据库。
"""

import asyncio
from contextlib import closing
import copy
import datetime
import io
from pathlib import Path
import sqlite3
import sys
import tempfile
from types import SimpleNamespace
import unittest
from unittest.mock import AsyncMock, patch
import urllib.error

from fastmcp import Client
from starlette.testclient import TestClient

with patch("dotenv.load_dotenv"):
    import main

import schedules
from server import create_app

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "mcp"))
import schedule_mcp

TZ8 = schedules.timezone_of(8)


def local(text: str) -> datetime.datetime:
    """东八区的本地时间。"""
    return datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(text).replace(tzinfo=TZ8)


MONDAY_8AM = local("2026-10-26T08:00:00")  # 2026-10-26 是星期一


def plan(repeat="daily", time="09:00", date="", weekdays=()):
    """next_run / summary 只看排期字段。"""
    return {"repeat": repeat, "time": time, "date": date, "weekdays": list(weekdays)}


def query(path, sql, params=()):
    with closing(sqlite3.connect(path)) as connection:
        return connection.execute(sql, params).fetchall()


class TempDatabase:
    def make_path(self):
        temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(temp.cleanup)
        self.path = str(Path(temp.name) / "data" / "db.sqlite3")

    def create(self, raw, now=MONDAY_8AM):
        return schedules.create_task(self.path, raw, now=now, tz=TZ8)

    def update(self, task_id, raw, now=MONDAY_8AM):
        return schedules.update_task(self.path, task_id, raw, now=now, tz=TZ8)

    def get(self, task_id, now=MONDAY_8AM):
        return schedules.get_task(self.path, task_id, now=now, tz=TZ8)

    def collect(self, now: str):
        return schedules.collect_due(self.path, now=local(now), tz=TZ8)


class NextRunTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def run_at(self, item, after):
        return schedules.next_run(item, local(after), TZ8)

    def test_daily_weekdays_and_weekly(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.run_at(plan(), "2026-10-26T08:00:00"), local("2026-10-26T09:00:00"))
        # 正好到点不算，往后找下一次
        self.assertEqual(self.run_at(plan(), "2026-10-26T09:00:00"), local("2026-10-27T09:00:00"))
        # 周五上午之后的下一个工作日是下周一
        self.assertEqual(self.run_at(plan("weekdays"), "2026-10-30T10:00:00"), local("2026-11-02T09:00:00"))
        weekly = plan("weekly", "20:00", weekdays=[1, 3])
        self.assertEqual(self.run_at(weekly, "2026-10-26T21:00:00"), local("2026-10-28T20:00:00"))
        self.assertEqual(self.run_at(weekly, "2026-10-28T20:00:00"), local("2026-11-02T20:00:00"))

    def test_hourly_and_once(self):
        hourly = plan("hourly", "00:15")
        self.assertEqual(self.run_at(hourly, "2026-10-26T08:00:00"), local("2026-10-26T08:15:00"))
        self.assertEqual(self.run_at(hourly, "2026-10-26T08:15:00"), local("2026-10-26T09:15:00"))
        self.assertEqual(self.run_at(hourly, "2026-10-26T23:59:59"), local("2026-10-27T00:15:00"))
        once = plan("once", "15:30:20", date="2026-10-26")
        self.assertEqual(self.run_at(once, "2026-10-26T08:00:00"), local("2026-10-26T15:30:20"))
        self.assertIsNone(self.run_at(once, "2026-10-26T15:30:20"))

    def test_fractional_timezone(self):
        run = schedules.next_run(plan(), datetime.datetime(2026, 10, 26, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc),
                                 schedules.timezone_of(5.5))
        self.assertEqual(run, datetime.datetime(2026, 10, 26, 3, 30, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc))
        self.assertEqual([schedules.timezone_label(offset) for offset in (8, 5.5, -3, 0)],
                         ["UTC+8", "UTC+5:30", "UTC-3", "UTC+0"])

    def test_summary_and_spoken_times(self):
        self.assertEqual(schedules.summary(plan()), "每天 09:00")
        self.assertEqual(schedules.summary(plan("weekdays", "08:30")), "工作日 08:30")
        self.assertEqual(schedules.summary(plan("weekly", "20:00", weekdays=[1, 3, 7])), "每周一、三、日 20:00")
        self.assertEqual(schedules.summary(plan("hourly", "00:15")), "每小时第 15 分")
        self.assertEqual(schedules.summary(plan("once", "15:30", date="2026-10-26")), "10月26日 15:30")

        def describe(text):
            return schedules.describe_time(local(text), MONDAY_8AM, TZ8)

        self.assertEqual(describe("2026-10-26T09:00:00"), "今天 09:00")
        self.assertEqual(describe("2026-10-27T07:30:00"), "明天 07:30")
        self.assertEqual(describe("2026-10-25T21:00:00"), "昨天 21:00")
        self.assertEqual(describe("2026-10-30T20:00:05"), "10月30日 星期五 20:00:05")
        self.assertEqual(describe("2027-01-01T08:00:00"), "2027年1月1日 星期五 08:00")

    def test_trigger_text(self):
        tasks = [{"prompt": "提醒大家喝水"}, {"prompt": "播报天气"}]
        self.assertEqual(schedules.trigger_text(tasks[:1]), "【定时任务】提醒大家喝水")
        self.assertEqual(schedules.trigger_text(tasks), "【定时任务】\n1. 提醒大家喝水\n2. 播报天气")


class StoreTest(TempDatabase, unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.make_path()

class CollectTest(TempDatabase, unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):

    def test_due_task_runs_once_then_waits_for_the_next(self):
        daily = self.create({"prompt": "喝水", "repeat": "daily", "time": "09:00"})
        self.assertEqual(self.collect("2026-10-26T08:30:00"), ([], local("2026-10-26T09:00:00")))
        due, wake = self.collect("2026-10-26T09:00:30")
        self.assertEqual([(task["id"], run) for task, run in due], [(daily["id"], local("2026-10-26T09:00:00"))])
        self.assertEqual(wake, local("2026-10-27T09:00:00"))
        self.assertEqual(self.get(daily["id"], now=local("2026-10-26T09:00:30"))["status_text"], "马上执行")
        schedules.mark_runs(self.path, [(daily["id"], local("2026-10-26T09:00:00"))], status="done")
        self.assertEqual(self.collect("2026-10-26T09:01:00"), ([], local("2026-10-27T09:00:00")))

    def test_runs_missed_while_harness_was_down_are_recorded(self):
        once = self.create({"prompt": "关火", "in_minutes": 10})  # 今天 08:10
        daily = self.create({"prompt": "喝水", "repeat": "daily", "time": "09:00"})
        # 三天后 09:05 才开机：每天的任务只补今天这一次，一次性的早过了宽限，记为错过
        due, wake = self.collect("2026-10-29T09:05:00")
        self.assertEqual([(task["id"], run) for task, run in due], [(daily["id"], local("2026-10-29T09:00:00"))])
        self.assertEqual(wake, local("2026-10-30T09:00:00"))
        missed = self.get(once["id"], now=local("2026-10-29T09:05:00"))
        self.assertEqual((missed["last_status"], missed["status_text"], missed["enabled"]), ("missed", "已错过", True))
        self.assertEqual(missed["last_run_at"], "2026-10-26T00:10:00+00:00")

        daily = self.create({"prompt": "喝水", "repeat": "daily", "time": "09:00"})
        self.update(daily["id"], {"enabled": False})
        self.assertEqual(self.collect("2026-10-26T09:01:00"), ([], None))
        # 09:05 才恢复：从恢复的时刻往后找，今天 09:00 那次不补
        self.update(daily["id"], {"enabled": True}, now=local("2026-10-26T09:05:00"))
        self.assertEqual(self.collect("2026-10-26T09:06:00"), ([], local("2026-10-27T09:00:00")))

    def test_wake_time_is_the_earliest_task(self):

        self.create({"prompt": "b", "repeat": "hourly", "time": "00:20"})
        self.assertEqual(self.collect("2026-10-26T08:00:00")[1], local("2026-10-26T08:20:00"))

class MainScheduleTest(TempDatabase, unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    def setUp(self):

        config = copy.deepcopy(main.DEFAULT_CONFIG)
        config["timezone"] = 8
        self.client = main.AIClient(config)
        self.bot = FakeBot()

    async def fake_restart(self):
        self.client.chat_bot, self.client.is_session_closed = self.bot, False

    @staticmethod
    def now():
        return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)

    async def settle(self):
        await asyncio.gather(*list(self.client._text_tasks))

    async def wait_until(self, condition):
        for _ in range(300):
            if condition():
                return
            await asyncio.sleep(0.01)
        self.fail("条件一直没有满足")

    async def run_loop(self, until):
        task = asyncio.create_task(self.client._schedule_loop())
        try:
            await self.wait_until(until)
        finally:
            task.cancel()
            await asyncio.gather(task, return_exceptions=True)

    async def test_due_tasks_reopen_a_closed_session_in_one_message(self):
        first = self.create({"prompt": "提醒大家喝水", "repeat": "daily", "time": "09:00"})
        second = self.create({"prompt": "播报天气", "repeat": "daily", "time": "09:00"})
        self.client.chat_bot, self.client.is_session_closed = FakeBot(), True  # 上一轮会话已经结束
        run = local("2026-10-26T09:00:00")
        with patch.object(self.client, "restart", AsyncMock(side_effect=self.fake_restart)) as restart:
            await self.client._run_scheduled([(first, run), (second, run)])
            await self.settle()
        restart.assert_awaited_once()
        self.assertEqual(self.bot.sent, [(schedules.trigger_text([first, second]), schedules.TRIGGER_INSTRUCTIONS)])
        self.assertEqual(query(self.path, "SELECT last_run_at, last_status, last_error FROM scheduled_tasks"),
                         [("2026-10-26T01:00:00+00:00", "done", None)] * 2)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.schedule_state["revision"], 1)

        task = self.create({"prompt": "喝水", "repeat": "daily", "time": "09:00"})
        self.client.chat_bot, self.client.is_playing = self.bot, True
        events = []

        async def finish_reply():
            await asyncio.sleep(0.05)
            events.append("回复说完")
            self.client.is_playing = False

        async def send_text(*args, **kwargs):
            events.append("定时任务")

        self.bot.send_text = send_text
        with patch.object(self.client, "restart", AsyncMock()) as restart:
            await asyncio.gather(finish_reply(), self.client._run_scheduled([(task, local("2026-10-26T09:00:00"))]))
            await self.settle()
        restart.assert_not_awaited()  # 会话开着就接在当前会话里
        self.assertEqual(events, ["回复说完", "定时任务"])

        task = self.create({"prompt": "喝水", "repeat": "daily", "time": "09:00"})
        self.client.chat_bot, self.client.is_playing = self.bot, True  # 一直在说（例如放歌）
        with patch.object(main, "SCHEDULE_IDLE_WAIT", 0):

        task = self.create({"prompt": "喝水", "repeat": "daily", "time": "09:00"})

        async def failed_restart():
            self.client.last_error = "TTS（豆包 v1）尚未配置：请在 .env 中填写 BYTEDANCE_TTS_APP_ID"

        now = self.now()
        clock = (now.astimezone(TZ8) - datetime.timedelta(minutes=1)).strftime("%H:%M")
        task = self.create({"prompt": "喝水", "repeat": "daily", "time": clock}, now=now - datetime.timedelta(hours=1))
        with patch.object(self.client, "restart", AsyncMock(side_effect=self.fake_restart)):
            await self.run_loop(lambda: self.bot.sent)
            await self.settle()
        self.assertEqual(self.bot.sent, [(schedules.TRIGGER_PREFIX + "喝水", schedules.TRIGGER_INSTRUCTIONS)])
        saved = self.get(task["id"], now=self.now())
        self.assertEqual(saved["last_status"], "done")
        self.assertTrue(saved["status_text"].startswith("下次 明天"))

    async def test_run_now_wakes_the_loop_and_keeps_the_schedule(self):
        clock = (self.now().astimezone(TZ8) + datetime.timedelta(hours=3)).strftime("%H:%M")
        task = self.create({"prompt": "播报天气", "repeat": "daily", "time": clock}, now=self.now())
        with patch.object(self.client, "restart", AsyncMock(side_effect=self.fake_restart)) as restart:
            loop = asyncio.create_task(self.client._schedule_loop())
            try:
                await asyncio.sleep(0.05)  # 循环算完下一次执行时间后睡下
                self.assertEqual(self.bot.sent, [])

                await self.wait_until(lambda: self.bot.sent)

        saved = self.get(task["id"], now=self.now())
        self.assertEqual(saved["last_status"], "done")
        self.assertTrue(saved["status_text"].startswith("下次 "))
        with self.assertRaises(schedules.TaskNotFound):
            await self.client.run_schedule_now(999)
